# Pixel Skill Lab (像素技能实验室)

> A browser-based pixel-art skill sandbox. Design active skills with a timeline editor, build passives as
> WHEN → IF → THEN rules, nest skills through Noita-style payloads, give buffs shader effects, and watch it all run
> live against enemies in a three.js arena. Free, static, no build step, no account.
> 一个像素风技能沙盒：用时间轴编排技能，用 触发器→条件→时间轴 搭建被动，Noita 式载荷无限嵌套，Buff 可给角色叠加着色器特效。

- Live app: https://pixel-skill-lab.pages.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/holooooo/pixel-skill-lab
- License: Apache-2.0
- Agent skill (SKILL.md) + zero-dependency CLI: https://github.com/holooooo/pixel-skill-lab/tree/main/skills/pixel-skill-lab
- Languages: 中文 (source) / English (toggle with the EN / 中 button, top right; choice is stored in localStorage `psl-lang`)

## What you can do on the page

1. **Play the arena** (center). WASD moves the hero, left click selects a target, right click moves, keys 1-8 cast the
   equipped skills, Tab cycles targets, P pauses. Standing near an enemy auto-attacks. The speed slider (top bar) slows
   time to inspect effects.
2. **Skill library** (left, tabs *Skills / Passives / Buff / Units·Arena*). Click a card to edit it. Drag a card onto the
   bottom hotbar (skills, up to 8) or passive bar (up to 6) to equip it. Card buttons: equip, duplicate, delete,
   export-to-clipboard.
3. **Timeline editor** (bottom). Drag action blocks from the palette onto tracks; drag horizontally to change the start
   time, vertically to change track. `← / →` nudge time, `Delete` removes, `Ctrl/⌘+D` duplicates a block.
   "▶ Test cast" fires the selected skill immediately.
4. **Inspector** (right). Edit the selected skill, block or buff. Damage is a formula: `base + Σ(ratio × stat)`, with
   stats such as ATK, max/current/missing HP, armor, magic resist, mana, event amount, **buff stacks** and
   **buff remaining DoT value**. Live damage preview is shown against the current target.
5. **Passives** are `WHEN trigger → IF conditions → THEN timeline`. 16 trigger events (on hit, on crit, on damaged,
   on kill, on cast, buff gained/applied/expired, low HP, shield break, dodge, healed, blink/dash, nearby enemy death,
   on spawn, every N seconds), 9 condition types (has/lacks buff, HP %, chance, distance, mana %, has shield, casting,
   stunned). Chain reactions are depth-limited to prevent infinite loops.
6. **Buffs** (Buff tab). DoT/HoT with tick formula, per-stack stat modifiers, crowd-control flags
   (stun / silence / root / disarm), and **character shader effects** (`vfx`).
7. **Units / Arena tab.** Spawn or clear enemies (Training Dummy, Slime, Lava Colossus), toggle enemy aggression,
   respawn, hero immortality, pixel size and bloom, reset the damage meter.
8. **Import / export** (top bar). Export one skill (dependent buffs and sub-skills are bundled) or the whole library as
   JSON; import from clipboard or via a one-click `#import=<base64url JSON>` link. Everything autosaves to the
   browser's localStorage (`pixel-skill-lab-v1`).

## Core concepts

- **Action blocks** (28): strike, projectile, laser, AoE burst, zone, chain, channel beam, apply/remove buff, shield,
  heal, blink, dash, knock/pull, self cost, cooldown adjust, cast skill, camera FX, **detonate**, execute, orbit,
  summon, swap, branch, repeat, spread, cleanse, mana, ...
- **Payloads (Noita style).** Projectiles can run another skill on *hit*, on *expire*, or on a *timer*; summons, loops
  and branches call skills too. Payload skills are free-cast from the trigger point and inherit direction; nesting is
  capped at 8 levels.
- **Detonate** reads a buff's stack count, deals formula damage × stacks and (optionally) clears the buff.
- **Settling DoTs** is pure data: a passive on `onHit` (kind = basic attack) running `detonate` with formula row
  `{ stat: "buffRemain", buff: "burn", src: "target", ratio: 1 }`, radius 0, consume on. The preset passive
  **Settle Detonation** (`settle`) does this for burn, poison and bleed.
- **Buff shader effects.** `buff.vfx = [{ type, color?, intensity?, speed? }]`, `type` is one of
  `glow, flash, bleed, burn, poison, frost, shock`. Several entries stack. Robot and sprite units get a real injected
  shader; VRM characters fall back to an emissive pulse.

## Data format (JSON, importable)

```json
{
  "format": "pixel-skill-lab", "version": 1,
  "abilities": [{
    "id": "iceShot", "kind": "active", "name": "冰锥", "icon": "冰", "color": "#6fe3ff",
    "cooldown": 2, "manaCost": 15, "range": 12, "targeting": "unit",
    "timeline": [{ "id": "b1", "type": "projectile", "t": 0, "track": 0,
      "p": { "aim": "target", "style": "frost", "buff": "slow",
             "formula": { "base": 40, "type": "magic", "canCrit": true, "rows": [{ "src": "caster", "stat": "atk", "ratio": 1 }] } } }]
  }],
  "buffs": { "slow": { "id": "slow", "name": "减速", "color": "#6fe3ff", "debuff": true, "duration": 2.5, "maxStacks": 1,
             "vfx": [{ "type": "frost", "intensity": 0.6 }] } }
}
```

Passive: `kind: "passive"`, `trigger: { event, kind?, buff?, pct?, every?, radius? }`, `conditions: [...]`, `icd` (seconds).

## Using it from an LLM / agent

Do not hand-write JSON blindly. Use the CLI in the repo (Node >= 18, no dependencies):

```bash
node tools/psl.mjs schema                 # all actions, triggers, conditions, formula stats, buff vfx types
node tools/psl.mjs schema projectile      # one action's parameters, defaults and ranges
node tools/psl.mjs list --kind passive    # presets to copy
node tools/psl.mjs new active iceShot --file my.json --name "冰锥"
node tools/psl.mjs add-block iceShot projectile --file my.json --set style='"frost"' --set buff='"slow"'
node tools/psl.mjs validate my.json --sim # schema check + headless battle simulation
node tools/psl.mjs link my.json           # one-click import URL for the user
npm test                                  # headless self-test of every preset
```

Install the agent skill: `cp -r skills/pixel-skill-lab ~/.claude/skills/`, then ask, e.g. "use pixel-skill-lab to make a
shotgun whose pellets split into 8 ice shards on hit". The skill file documents the workflow, formula stats, the
`vfx` field and recipes.

## Run locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/holooooo/pixel-skill-lab && cd pixel-skill-lab
python3 -m http.server 5178     # open http://localhost:5178
```

Static files only; three.js and @pixiv/three-vrm load from the jsDelivr CDN, so an internet connection is required.

## Source map

- `index.html`, `css/style.css` – layout and styles
- `js/main.js` – app shell, input, main loop · `js/editor.js` – library / timeline / inspectors · `js/hud.js` – HUD
- `js/engine/` – `battle.js` (units, stats, buffs, damage, triggers), `actions.js` (action blocks), `model.js`
  (stats, formulas, triggers, `VFX_TYPES`)
- `js/render/` – `arena.js` (three.js scene), `unitfx.js` (buff shader effects), `sprites.js` (procedural pixel art)
- `js/data/presets.js` – preset skills, passives, buffs, enemies · `js/store.js` – persistence, import/export
- `js/i18n.js` – zh→en dictionary + MutationObserver translation
- `tools/psl.mjs` – agent CLI · `tools/selftest.mjs` – headless tests · `skills/pixel-skill-lab/SKILL.md`
